text:
Ivy (Support): FYI customer (ACME) reporting intermittent API timeouts when we call their on-prem HSM for signing. They see spikes in latency and billing anomalies. Can someone help triage?

Sam (Eng): Can you paste the minimal error and a repro? Also which HSM vendor/firmware?

Ivy (Support): Error from our gateway: `error: \"hsm_timeout\", code: HSM_TIMEOUT`
```
POST /v1/keys/abcd1234/sign HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{ "digest": "..." }

HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "hsm_timeout", "code": "HSM_TIMEOUT", "trace": "req_0f3b" }
```
Customer says this started after a scheduled maintenance at ~2026-03-03T02:05Z. Vendor is an on-prem PKCS#11 appliance (serial SN-XYZ).

Maria (SRE): From metrics: sign latency (p50) jumped from ~120ms to ~900ms, p95 ~5s in the incident window. Concurrent PKCS11 sessions peaked near 1024 which is our configured max for that pool. We also saw socket retries to HSM (TCP RSTs).

Ingrid (Security): Are audit logs available for the HSM during the gap? We need to confirm no keys were exported or unexpected admin ops. Also need KMS audit trail for calls and user principal.

Ivy (Support): Customer says their HSM audit shows a gap 2026-03-03 02:00-02:45Z. Our platform audit (key use logs) shows repeated `HSM_TIMEOUT` entries for that window.

Sam (Eng): Likely session exhaustion + device flapping after firmware update. Two-pronged ask: 1) reproduce locally (we can simulate session leaks), 2) collection plan for vendor escalation.

Ivy (Support): Repro steps they shared:
```
# simple loop to call sign
for i in $(seq 1 2000); do
  curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"digest":"..."}' \
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/abcd1234/sign || echo "fail $i"
  sleep 0.01
done
```
They say failures start ~700 calls in.

Maria (SRE): Quick checks: confirm PKCS11 session reuse in our signer code (we pool sessions). If we leak sessions on certain error paths, a firmware restart will free them but while it's restarting you'll hit timeouts. Check server logs for `CKR_DEVICE_ERROR` or `CKR_SESSION_COUNT` messages.

Sam (Eng): I found this in our logs at 02:07: 
```
2026-03-03T02:07:13Z HSM: PKCS11 error CKR_DEVICE_ERROR during C_Sign
2026-03-03T02:07:14Z HSM: connection dropped, reconnecting
2026-03-03T02:07:18Z HSM: session open failed: CKR_SESSION_COUNT
```
That matches vendor restart.

DeployBot: detected onprem-hsm-appliance SN-XYZ firmware upgrade completed at 2026-03-03T02:05:45Z.

Ingrid (Security): Ok we need vendor logs and do an integrity check. Action items: request HSM audit bundle from customer (signed), get appliance syslogs, and provide serial + firmware version to vendor. Also collect our key usage logs (UUIDs, timestamps, calling principal IPs).

Ivy (Support): I've asked customer to export HSM audit bundle and syslog. They will upload to our secure intake bucket.

Maria (SRE): Mitigation options for customer while we triage: 1) increase session_pool_size and max sessions on appliance if vendor supports, 2) enable session caching so we don't open/close per-request, 3) route low-sensitivity signs to software signer (temporary), 4) failover to a dedicated spare HSM if they have one. Recommend increasing our request timeout to 10s for now to reduce 500s.

Sam (Eng): Code-side: add aggressive retry/backoff on CKR_DEVICE_ERROR and ensure we close leaked session handles in finally blocks. I can open a PR to add more robust session reclaiming logic.

Ingrid (Security): Also note: audit gap is a compliance flag. We need to prepare a timeline for legal/compliance and list impacted keys/principals. If the vendor confirms the device restarted for firmware, ask if the restart could have dropped audit writes — we need vendor attestation.

Ivy (Support): Customer also flagged unexpected billing surge for signing calls during the incident window. Asking finance for temporary credit until we determine root cause.

Maria (SRE): I'll collect metrics (session_count, sign latencies, socket resets) and attach graphs. Sam — can you draft the vendor escalation payload (serial, firmware, syslog snippets, PKCS11 errors)?

Sam (Eng): On it. Draft will include: appliance SN, firmware 3.2.1-rc, kernel logs, PKCS11 errors, exact timestamps, and a minimal repro curl loop.

Ivy (Support): Customer uploaded HSM audit bundle (link) and syslog to intake. I'll share link in private thread with vendor team.

Ingrid (Security): Once vendor responds, get a signed statement on whether keys or audits could be compromised. Also confirm HSM tamper sensors and key custody state.

Maria (SRE): Next steps summary:
- Collect vendor appliance logs + signed audit bundle (Ivy)
- Attach our platform key usage logs + error traces (Maria)
- PR for session-reclaiming + timeout tweaks (Sam)
- Security timeline & compliance notification (Ingrid)
- Finance review for credit (Ivy)

Ivy (Support): Thanks team — I'll keep the customer updated. Will post vendor response here when available. :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng): If anyone wants to pair on the PR/validation, ping me.

DeployBot: incident linked: INC-2026-224 onprem-hsm-signing-latency
